Report Day

Full formation. No shortcuts.

Every cohort starts the same way — lined up, in uniform, in front of the apparatus bay. This is what the first morning looks like.

Programs

Three paths in. One standard.

Every track ends at the same bar: NFPA-certified, operationally ready. Pick the pace that fits your life.

12 Weeks · Full Immersion

Full-Time Program

A fully immersive, three-month experience on campus — the fastest route from recruit to certified. You live the schedule of a working firehouse: drills, classroom, chores, repeat.

Certifications Earned

  • 🏅 NFPA 1001 Firefighter Level I & II
  • 🏅 NFPA 470 HazMat Awareness & Operations
16 Weeks · 13 Online + 3 In-Person

Blended Program

Classroom theory completed online over 13 weeks, then everything converges into 3 intense weeks of on-campus drills and mock scenarios. Built for recruits balancing work or distance.

Certifications Earned

  • 🏅 NFPA 1001 Firefighter Level I & II
  • 🏅 NFPA 470 HazMat Awareness & Operations
40 Hours · In Person

EFR Upgrade Program

A focused, in-person upgrade for anyone who already needs Emergency First Responder credentials — compressed, practical, and built around real medical-response scenarios.

Certification Earned

  • 🏅 Canadian Red Cross EFR Certification
